summary: Promote Planfile backlog from monag before paid idle discovery

delivery.outcome: When the autonomous loop is idle and scan, code2llm and todo2code created nothing, Koru reads the project-scoped monag resume inventory, moves a bounded number of unambiguous open backlog tickets into the current sprint and skips the paid nxdo planner when it promoted existing work; unfinished ticket worktrees are reported read-only.
nonGoals: Resume, take over, reset or delete any existing worktree
Create new tickets from monag data or GitHub issues
Move tickets from legacy root planfile.yaml, worktree copies or tickets with conflicting statuses
Change monag, Planfile or the nxdo planner

architecture.decision: Add an optional monag adapter to the existing idle discovery fallback chain directly before nxdo. It shells out to the read-only monag CLI, accepts only primary-checkout sprint sources, verifies the ticket is absent from the current sprint and promotes through the Planfile CLI move command.
architecture.rollback: Set KORU_MONAG_ENABLE=0 or revert the ticket commit; promoted tickets stay valid current-sprint tickets.
